candidates.explanation: PrizeVault.maxDeposit is an ERC-4626 max/limit function that uses the APPROXIMATE converttoassets( wrapping an external max* redemption instead of the EIP-4626-mandated exact preview* — so it may over/under-report, breaking 4626 compliance and downstream integrations (PoolTogether M-02 class).
candidates.false_positive_controls: two-signal (is-4626 vault context + max/limit/preview fn using approximate convertTo* where EIP-4626 mandates preview*); non-4626 / preview-correct / documented suppressed; narrow scope (precision over recall)
